data.gender_notes: Vikey is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vik', which means 'victory'. The suffix 'key' means 'little' or 'small'. This name is a reminder of the victories that come from within, and the strength and wisdom needed to overcome challenges. The name Vikey carries the meaning “Little Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Vikey usually hope their child will grow to embody little victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
